CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pgtrigger_update_aggregated_status_f18c4()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
                
                BEGIN
                    IF ("public"._pgtrigger_should_ignore(TG_NAME) IS TRUE) THEN
                        IF (TG_OP = 'DELETE') THEN
                            RETURN OLD;
                        ELSE
                            RETURN NEW;
                        END IF;
                    END IF;
                    
                    NEW.aggregated_status := CASE
                        WHEN NEW.state != 'done' THEN NEW.state
                        ELSE COALESCE((
                            SELECT CASE
                                WHEN bool_or(msg->>'log_level' = 'error') THEN 'error'
                                WHEN bool_or(msg->>'log_level' = 'warning') THEN 'warning'
                                WHEN bool_or(msg->>'log_level' = 'info') THEN 'info'
                                ELSE 'done'
                            END
                            FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW._messages) AS msg
                        ), 'done')
                    END;

                    RETURN NEW;
                
                END;
            $function$

public.authentik_core_groupancestry.definition:
WITH RECURSIVE accumulator AS (
         SELECT (authentik_core_groupparentage.child_id::text || '-'::text) || authentik_core_groupparentage.parent_id::text AS id,
            authentik_core_groupparentage.child_id AS descendant_id,
            authentik_core_groupparentage.parent_id AS ancestor_id
           FROM authentik_core_groupparentage
        UNION
         SELECT (accumulator_1.descendant_id::text || '-'::text) || current.parent_id::text AS id,
            accumulator_1.descendant_id,
            current.parent_id AS ancestor_id
           FROM accumulator accumulator_1
             JOIN authentik_core_groupparentage current ON accumulator_1.ancestor_id = current.child_id
        )
 SELECT id,
    descendant_id,
    ancestor_id
   FROM accumulator;
